hooks.command: payload=$(cat || true); command -v gryphon >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | { python -c 'import sys,json;ti=(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {});print(ti.get("file_path") or ti.get("filePath") or "")' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c 'import sys,json;ti=(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {});print(ti.get("file_path") or ti.get("filePath") or "")' 2>/dev/null; }); crg_dir=${f:+$(dirname "$f" 2>/dev/null)}; r=$(cd "${crg_dir:-.}" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; gryphon update --skip-postprocess --min-interval 60 --repo "$r" || true
